The test contains multiple assertions (two) verifying different observable properties (edge existence and vertex count). Decision rule: >=2 assertions verifying properties => compliant.
There are no @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test methods in the provided method. The test is active and runnable.
Class-level Javadoc explicitly includes 'Requirement traceability: REQ-DS-001', satisfying traceability requirement (class-level comments count).

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: The test uses @Test(timeout = 4000), which is an explicit timing assertion indicating performance consideration; per decision rules this qualifies as a performance-related test annotation.
The method name 'test5' is generic and does not describe the scenario or expected behavior. Decision rule: generic name => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: There are clear signs of test-generation tools: imports from org.evosuite.runtime, @RunWith(EvoRunner.class), and a generic method name 'test5', indicating auto-generated style. Decision rule: signs of heavy code generation => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: No Given-When-Then comments or BDD-style naming are present in the method, and the class contains only a minimal happy-path test. Decision rules: lack of BDD structure and minimal tests => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test interacts only with public Grafo API methods (insereAresta, existeAresta, numVertices) and does not use reflection or access private internals. Decision rule: calls public methods only => compliant.
Assertions lack descriptive failure messages. While specific assertion methods are used, none include messages; decision rule: <50% of assertions have messages => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.justification: No commented-out code or excessive inline comments are present. Class-level Javadoc documents purpose and traceability; method is concise and self-explanatory.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects

The test performs a single Arrange-Act-Assert: constructs Grafo, calls numVertices(), and asserts the result. Only one method call is being tested, fulfilling atomicity.

The test uses only local variables and does not rely on shared mutable state or execution order. No @Before/@After are present but the method is self-contained, so it meets independence criteria based on visible code.
